financial_covenants.name: Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio

citation.source_text: Not permit the Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the last day of any fiscal quarter to be less than 1.25 to 1.00, tested as of the last day of each fiscal quarter beginning with the fiscal quarter ending March 31, 2021.

financial_covenants.definition: (1) Fixed Charge Operating Cash Flow, divided by (2) Fixed Charges, all as determined for Borrower and its Subsidiaries on a consolidated basis in accordance with GAAP. The Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio shall be calculated on a trailing twelve (12) month basis ending as of the last day of each test period.

resolved_definition.formula: (EBITDA - (unfinanced Capital Expenditures + income taxes paid in cash + dividends, distributions and Equity Interest redemptions paid in cash) + min(PPP Loan Proceeds - (Non-forgivable Uses), PPP Loan Forgiveness)) / ((Total Interest Expense + Capitalized Lease Interest + Preferred Equity Interest + LC/BA Fees + Rate Management Net Costs) + Principal Payments on Indebtedness (excl. PPP Forgivable Uses forgiven under CARES Act) + Principal Payments on Capital Leases)

Fixed Charges.formula: (Total Interest Expense + Capitalized Lease Interest + Preferred Equity Interest + LC/BA Fees + Rate Management Net Costs) + Principal Payments on Indebtedness (excl. PPP Forgivable Uses forgiven under CARES Act) + Principal Payments on Capital Leases

Interest Expense.formula: Total Interest Expense + Capitalized Lease Interest + Preferred Equity Interest + LC/BA Fees + Rate Management Net Costs

carve_outs: excluding Interest Expense in respect of that portion of the PPP Loan that is used for funding Forgivable Uses), plus (2) scheduled payments, required payments and prepayments of principal on Indebtedness (excluding principal in respect of that portion of the PPP Loan that is used for funding Forgivable Uses

Fixed Charge Operating Cash Flow.formula: EBITDA - (unfinanced Capital Expenditures + income taxes paid in cash + dividends, distributions and Equity Interest redemptions paid in cash) + min(PPP Loan Proceeds - (Non-forgivable Uses), PPP Loan Forgiveness)

Equity Interest.formula: Common Stock + Preferred Stock + Warrants + Membership Interests + Convertible Securities + Other Equity Interests

Capital Expenditures.formula: Fixed Asset Expenditures + Capitalized Lease Obligations - Insurance-Reimbursed Expenditures

carve_outs: provided that, such amount shall not exceed the amount that is forgiven pursuant to the PPP Loan program.
